newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf winter wheat, corn and soybean basis values were unchanged Friday amid light dealings, grain dealers said.

Egypt said Friday it will accept offers until Saturday morning for 50,000 tonnes of U.S., Australian or French wheat for June 1 to 14 shipment. FOB wheat dealers said if Egypt buys U.S. wheat, FOB values could increase slightly.
However, the prompt shipment requirement would favor France making the sale rather than the U.S. or Australia, U.S. exporters said.
